boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named stops on or beside St. Joseph’s College Avenue–Minnesota Street downtown corridor, a practical off-campus destination area from Saint John’s University.

cards.title: Flour & Flower Bakery: pastries and bouquets
cards.subtitle: College Avenue–Minnesota Street downtown corridor • 24 N College Ave
cards.notes: Stop in for the bakery’s daily pastries or artisan breads, then browse its locally grown flower bouquets before continuing along College Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A College Avenue bakery that also carries fresh flower bouquets.
cards.evidence_claim: Flour & Flower Bakery identifies itself as a St. Joseph bakery offering fresh daily pastries, artisan baked goods, and locally grown flower bouquets at 24 N College Ave.
cards.access_notes: Verify hours before visiting; the business posts varying daily hours.

cards.title: The Wandering Cow: ice cream stop
cards.subtitle: College Avenue–Minnesota Street downtown corridor • 14 N College Ave, Suite B
cards.notes: Use the College Avenue storefront for a scoop, shaved ice, or shake; confirm the day’s hours on the shop’s contact page first.
cards.short_summary: A family-friendly ice-cream shop directly on College Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wandering Cow lists its St. Joseph shop at 14 College Ave N, Suite B and says it serves ice cream, shaved ice, and shakes.
cards.access_notes: The business lists daily hours on its contact page; check them before heading over.

cards.title: Gary’s Pizza: pizza and pickup
cards.subtitle: College Avenue–Minnesota Street downtown corridor • 17 N College Ave
cards.notes: Use the St. Joseph location for pizza, pasta, salads, or flatbreads; order online or check with the shop for current store hours.
cards.short_summary: A College Avenue pizzeria with dine-in, pickup, and delivery options.
cards.evidence_claim: Gary’s Pizza lists its St. Joseph location at 17 North College Avenue and identifies pizza, pasta, salads, flatbreads, and other menu items.
cards.access_notes: Use the business’s ordering link or contact it to confirm current hours and service options.

cards.title: Bo Diddley’s Deli: sandwich pickup
cards.subtitle: College Avenue–Minnesota Street downtown corridor • 19 N College Ave
cards.notes: Place a pickup order or walk in for a sandwich, soup, or fresh-sliced meat menu item at the St. Joseph College Avenue location.
cards.short_summary: A locally operated deli on College Avenue with pickup ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: Bo Diddley’s lists its St. Joseph deli at 19 College Ave N and offers pickup ordering; its site describes fresh-sliced meat, sandwiches, and homemade soup.
cards.access_notes: The location page lists daily hours; confirm them before visiting.

cards.title: The Local Blend: coffee and baked goods
cards.subtitle: College Avenue–Minnesota Street downtown corridor • 19 W Minnesota St
cards.notes: Choose a coffee, tea, smoothie, or house-made baked good, then use the Minnesota Street address as a starting point for the downtown block.
cards.short_summary: A Minnesota Street café with coffee, food, and an in-house baking program.
cards.evidence_claim: The Local Blend lists its location at 19 West Minnesota Street and describes coffee, tea, smoothies, homemade food, and in-house baked goods.
cards.access_notes: The business publishes daily hours on its website; check for changes before going.

cards.title: Minnesota Street Market: food and local art
cards.subtitle: College Avenue–Minnesota Street downtown corridor • 27 W Minnesota St
cards.notes: Browse locally produced food and art inside the former Loso’s Family Grocery Store, then use the back-door or Minnesota Street parking guidance if needed.
cards.short_summary: A downtown food-and-art cooperative in a historic grocery-store building.
cards.evidence_claim: Minnesota Street Market describes itself as a food and art co-op in downtown St. Joseph and lists its location at 27 West Minnesota Street.
cards.access_notes: The market’s contact page gives parking guidance; check its website for current store information.

cards.entity_name: St. Joseph Meat Market Processing Plant
cards.title: St. Joseph Meat Market: local sausage counter
cards.subtitle: College Avenue–Minnesota Street downtown corridor • 17 W Minnesota St
cards.notes: Use the Minnesota Street processing-plant address when seeking the market’s locally made sausage and meat products; confirm which services are available there.
cards.short_summary: A long-running local meat business with a Minnesota Street processing location.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Joseph Meat Market lists its processing plant at 17 W Minnesota St and says it provides fresh meat and homemade sausage in central Minnesota.
cards.access_notes: Its website distinguishes the retail store from the processing plant; contact the business to confirm visitor services.

cards.title: Floral Arts Inc: flower pickup
cards.subtitle: College Avenue–Minnesota Street downtown corridor • 307 1st Ave NE
cards.notes: Walk one block from the Minnesota Street corridor to arrange a bouquet pickup or browse floral gifts; use the shop’s listed address and posted hours.
cards.short_summary: A St. Joseph florist immediately beside the downtown corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Floral Arts Inc lists its store and pickup address as 307 1st Ave NE in St. Joseph and offers floral designs, bouquets, and plants.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists operating hours; verify availability for a specific floral order.

cards.title: Krewe Restaurant: New Orleans menu
cards.subtitle: College Avenue–Minnesota Street downtown corridor • 24 N College Ave, Suite 104
cards.notes: Reserve or order ahead for the restaurant’s New Orleans-inspired menu, using the College Avenue address and the restaurant’s posted meal periods.
cards.short_summary: A downtown St. Joseph restaurant serving a New Orleans-inspired menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Krewe Restaurant identifies its location as 24 College Avenue North, Suite 104, in downtown St. Joseph and describes its New Orleans heritage menu.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant posts meal periods and reservation options on its official site; verify before visiting.

cards.title: CSB+SJU Spirit Shop: campus gear
cards.subtitle: College Avenue–Minnesota Street downtown corridor • 37 S College Ave
cards.notes: Continue south on College Avenue to shop Bennie, Johnnie, and shared CSB+SJU gear at the College of Saint Benedict location.
cards.short_summary: The shared campus spirit shop at the south end of College Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: CSB+SJU Spirit Shop lists a CSB location at 37 College Ave S in St. Joseph and offers Bennie, Johnnie, and CSB+SJU gear.
cards.access_notes: The official shop site posts store-hour information; check it before making the trip.
